Credits:

Track Name: Yaad Aaye Hai
Singer, Composer, Lyrics: Kalakaari Banjara
Music Director: Shamir Tandon
Music Supervisor: Ahan Shah
Lyrics Supervisor: Pinky Poonawala
Arranged and programmed by: Nabeel Zubair
Mixed and Mastered by :
Dolby Atmos :Team CFP
Head Mix Engineer - Nikhil Mathew
Assisted by - Abhishek Poojary, Gayatri Karekar, Subhashree Das
Mixes supervised by Sunny M.R. for Chordfather Productions
Vocal Coaches: Bhavya Pandit & Divya S Iyer
Music Operations Head : Tannishtha Puri & Anany Kakade
Audio Post Production: Gopal Thakare
Tech Supervision: Madhur Hatiskar

Lyrics:

VERSE 1

Istmal-e-dil kamaal ka kiya
You made such extraordinary use of my heart.

Marhaba bemisaal sa kiya
And you did it in a way that was truly remarkable and incomparable.

Uff kya kamaal hai teri aqal
Oh, what a clever mind you have.

Humne toh bas tera khayal tha kiya
All I ever did was think of you.

PRE-CHORUS

Mohabbat baqadar shamsheer si chali
Love struck like a sharp sword.

Dil ko qatal karke behaal kyun kiya
Why did you destroy my heart and leave me so helpless?

CHORUS

Sunlo, tum aaj dil-e-zar ki sunwaayee hai
Listen today, the wounded heart finally gets its hearing.

Har lafz pe mere dard-e-dil ki gawahi hai
Every word I speak bears witness to the pain in my heart.

Uski yaadon ne dil pe dastakay lagayi hai
Her memories have knocked upon my heart again.

Aayi hai, yaad uski aayi hai
Her memory has returned to me.


Lagta hai faut hone ki ab naubat aayi hai
It feels as though I have reached the point of death.

Musalsal zindagi aur maut ki ladayi hai
It is a constant battle between life and death.

Meri in aankhon mein ab bhi uski parchhayi hai
Her shadow still remains in my eyes.

Aayi hai, yaad uski aayi hai
Her memory has returned to me.

VERSE 2

Ye raat raat bhar, baat baat , Darpan ke saath Kare hum kyun? 
Why do I spend the whole night talking to my own reflection, lost in thoughts?

Aise halaat, meri yeh zaat, meri Sifaat hai gum kyun? 
In such circumstances, my very identity, my qualities why have they all disappeared? 

Meri hayat, meri jane-jana, meri rehnumayi hai gum kyun? 
My life, my beloved, the one dearest to my life, my Guidance, why has it all disappeared? 

Ye haal-e-haq, na raaz-e-gam, naraaz sanns phir gam kyun? 
This is the truth of my condition, and I have no secret left to hide my sorrow.
Even my breaths seem upset with me, and still I am feeling sadness.

PRE-CHORUS 2

Ab kis se kahun apna yeh haal-e-dil
Who do I tell about the condition of my heart now?

Tune mujhe itna behaal kyun kiya
Why did you leave me in such a helpless, broken state?

Chorus Repeats
